critical_code_review_comments: routers/analytics.py analytics_carts and customers.py customer_360 issue N+1 queries — one products.find_one per cart item / abandoned cart / order item. Should batch with $in.
routers/orders.py create_order fetches each product one-by-one from the cart in a loop; also N+1. Batch with $in.
routers/coupons.py validate re-fetches each already-applied coupon inside the loop; could be a single $in on codes.
routers/coupons.py bulk_create_coupons inserts one at a time in a loop (up to 5000). Prefer bulk_write / insert_many for scale.

routers/wallet.py add_wallet_entry computes balance_after by fully re-summing the ledger for every insert — O(n) per write and race-condition prone under concurrency. Cache balance on user or use atomic $inc on a wallet doc.
routers/orders.py cancel-refund path is not idempotent-safe against concurrent cancel calls (ledger duplicate guard uses find, not a unique index). Add a unique index on (order_id, reason='refund').
routers/orders.py _reserve_inventory rollback on failure could itself fail silently; wrap in try/except and surface partial-rollback.
routers/customers.py favourite_products keys by product name (not id) — two products with same name would collide.
routers/analytics.py RAZORPAY_FEE_PCT hardcoded; move to settings.
routers/pincodes.py update_pincode does not re-check location_id validity (only create does).
personalization.py at 379 lines is nearing the 700-line limit; not urgent.
